description: Dependency update pull requests. Runs once the Renovate GitHub app is installed on the repository (docs/ROADMAP.md, 'Needs the owner').
Covers GitHub Actions (SHA pins), the jdx/mise-action 'version:' inputs, mise.toml, the npm packages of the browser package and the VS Code extension, NuGet and Maven.

Updated by hand: the Unity Mono download in the Dockerfile and lua-language-server in tools/luals/install.sh (both checked against a SHA-256), the Unity editor images in unity.yml (pinned by digest), the wasm-tools workload version in hosting.yml, and the Unity package manifests.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes skip the waiting period and are never merged automatically.

customManagers.description: The mise release that jdx/mise-action installs. Every workflow writes it under the same comment.
matchStrings: # A mise release older than seven days\.\s+version: (?<currentValue>\d+\.\d+\.\d+)

packageRules.description: Majors are separate PRs that wait for approval on the Dependency Dashboard.
A 0.x minor can break like a major.
Workflow changes use the ci type.
One PR for non-major workflow updates.
The .NET SDK in mise.toml and the wasm-tools workload in hosting.yml move together.
prBodyNotes: Also set `dotnet workload install wasm-tools --version` in `.github/workflows/hosting.yml`, `AGENTS.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md` to the workload set of the new SDK, and build the browser package before merging.

packageRules.description: The source generator must load in Unity 2021.3's compiler, which needs Microsoft.CodeAnalysis 3.8 (docs/source-generator.md).
NUnit 3.5.0 is the net45 test runner's version and 3.13.3 the netstandard2.0 one; both are moved by hand with the Mono and Unity runs.
NLua is the old comparison baseline of PerformanceComparison.
@types/vscode must match engines.vscode, the oldest VS Code the extension supports.
engines fields are support floors, not pins.
One PR for non-major updates of the browser package.
One PR for non-major updates of the VS Code extension.
One PR for non-major updates of the Java client and sample.
